newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 surges to new 12-m high led by Komercni.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 surges to new 12-m high led by Komercni.

text.p: The Czech PX50 soared to a new 12-month high on Thursday with the index's most heavily capitalised banking issue, Komercni Banka, applying most of the upward pressure.
The PX50 closed up 6.2 points, 1.02 percent to 613.4 while the major issue dominated RPIX index gained 19.7 points, 1.52 percent to 1,318.5.

Komercni rose 117 points, 4.2 percent to 2,905 driven, dealers said, by strong long term arbitrage possibilities exisiting between Komercni's price on the Prague Stock Exchange and its global depositary receipts (GDR's) in London.
"It is definitely not normal. There's clear arbitrage opportunity - although this cannot be realised at the moment," sad Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
Komercni's GDR's were quoted in London in late afternoon at 3,446 crowns, implying a differential with their Prague share price of 541 crowns.
However, arbitrage possibilities could only be realised after a change in Czech law which currently prevents foreigners from buying shares in domestic banks without central bank permission.
Apart from Komercni, the PX50 was also boosted by SPT Telecom which rose 60 crowns, 1.5 percent, to 3,960 and CEZ, which rose seven crowns, 0.6 percent, to 1,227.

Refineries Kaucuk and Chemopetrol attracted considerable attention and moved in different directions after a morning newspaper report gave details of the share swap ratio in the prospective merger of the two into one petrochemical group - Unipetrol.
Kaucuk rose 19 crowns to 1,364 while Chemoptrol dropped six crowns to 1,291.

Czech daily Hospodarske Noviny quoted an unnamed source as saying that shareholders in Kaucuk would receive 12 shares in Unipetrol with a nominal value of 100 crowns for each current share with a nominal value of 1,000 crowns.
Chemopetrol would get 11 Unipetrol shares for every share they currently hold.
Overall on the bourse, turnover reached 2.8 billion crowns, with volume rising to 2,124,425 shares.
